title: Resolve, Authorizing the Commissioner of Administrative and Financial Services to Convey the Interests of the State in Certain Real Property in East Millinocket

summary.text: This resolve authorizes the Commissioner of Administrative and Financial Services to enter into an option agreement with the Town of East Millinocket for the sale of all or portions of land surrounding and including the state property known as "the Dolby Landfill" in the Town of East Millinocket.
